purpose: Fail-closed, source-first thumbnail production using Codex image generation as the approved primary non-proof support layer and local AI as resilient secondary tooling.

roles.city: Tall condensed city lockup; largest only in the city-search hypothesis.
roles.hook: Expressive display face with custom fit, restrained outline, directional shadow, and no generic black card.
roles.support: Optional. Omit it when the hook already answers the visual question.

blocked_patterns: map label treated as a second headline
small slogan that fails at mobile shelf size

priority: rights-cleared historical street-life or people photograph tied to the claim
source-rich map or document only when the map itself is the mystery
AI non-proof support layer behind a visible real proof object
hero_asset_rules.then_now: Use photo/photo or map/map only. Do not use a map as the THEN image opposite a modern photograph.
hero_asset_rules.ai_support: AI may restore, relight, extend, or add atmosphere, but it cannot create historical proof or be the only visible factual object.
hero_asset_rules.preflight: Do not render a final then/now candidate until both rights-cleared panels are available and accepted.

generation_stack.primary_generation: Codex built-in image generation, owner-approved for non-proof support assets
generation_stack.final_composite: deterministic SVG/HTML/Sharp or existing local renderer
generation_stack.fallback_rule: If Codex image generation is unavailable, use a verified local model. Do not silently replace source proof with generated imagery.

model_routing.paid_openai_api_default: owner-approved standing authority for Pattern Lab thumbnail non-proof support assets only
model_routing.local_ai_role: secondary resilient fallback and batch support generation

hypothesis_families.rule: Three finalists must differ in information hierarchy and viewer reason to click, not merely colors or crops.

completion_contract.prepublication_100: All deterministic gates pass, all finalists score at least 94, exact candidate hash is owner-approved at 9/10 or better, and no public mutation occurs.
completion_contract.empirical_winner: After separate publication approval, native YouTube testing selects by watch-time quality; CTR alone is insufficient.
